evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule that contradicts allowing anonymous users to view sponsors.
No other story explicitly restricts viewing user profiles to a different role or imposes an incompatible privacy rule that forbids anonymous viewing.
No story imposes an incompatible restriction on emailing trainers from the website or contradicts the coordinator's ability to do so.
No conflicting story imposes an incompatible constraint about maps or room visibility for attendees.
No other story forbids trainers from editing their training nodes or imposes a contradictory ownership rule.
Although other stories describe registrations, none explicitly conflict with enforcing one registration per day per authenticated user.
No other story imposes an incompatible rule about admin views tracking registration status.
No other story forbids waitlisting or imposes a contradictory rule about waitlist behavior.
No story conflicts with requiring acceptance of cancellation terms via checkbox; other cancellation-related stories are compatible.
Tying a cancellation deadline into the registration/cancellation workflow does not conflict with other stories; it complements BC-009.
Adding to 'my schedule' (if the feature exists) is not contradicted by any other story.
Viewing trainings a user has signed up for does not conflict with other stories about registrations or schedules.
Giving trainers a view of attendee information is not in direct contradiction with any other story that mandates exclusive different access; no story forbids trainers from seeing attendee info.
An admin view showing trainee information complements other admin/trainer view stories and does not contradict them.
Providing a public class page with details and a SEO-friendly URL does not conflict with other stories.
Listing training options with specified details is consistent with other training-listing and detail stories.
A training landing page and list of offerings does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
A home-page link to training options is consistent with other navigation and listing stories.
Providing location/time info for coding lounge does not conflict with other backlog items.
Administrators refunding sponsorship money via Stripe does not conflict with any payment or sponsor stories.
An authenticated user finding a link to become a sponsor is compatible with other sponsorship and payment stories.
Allowing anonymous users to see attendees associated with a company is not explicitly contradicted by any story that restricts that association to other roles.
Authenticated users identifying and paying for sponsorship is consistent with other sponsorship and payment stories.
Administrators creating and maintaining venues does not conflict with other venue or schedule stories.
Viewing venue details is compatible with admin venue maintenance and other location-related stories.
Showing sessions associated with sponsor attendees does not impose an incompatible rule with other sponsor/session items.
Providing a payment page as part of registration for authenticated users aligns with other payment and registration stories and does not contradict them.
Administrator assignment of sponsors to events/training is consistent with sponsor-feature stories and does not conflict.
Showing all events a sponsor sponsors is compatible with assignment and sponsor-profile stories.
Charging a card for an individual sponsorship is consistent with other payment stories; no incompatible constraints are present.
Sponsor linking attendees to sponsorship page is not in conflict with other stories about attendee visibility or sponsor pages.
Authenticated users updating their profile does not conflict with any story; no exclusive access contradiction exists.
Anonymous newsletter signup does not contradict other stories; no rule forbids anonymous signup.
Admin tagging blog posts for Drupal Planet is compatible with content publishing stories; no contradictory constraint exists.
Admin creating blog posts aligns with other blog/read stories; no conflicting behavior is imposed elsewhere.
Anonymous users reading the blog does not conflict with content creation or tagging requirements.
Sponsor sponsoring a summit to match brand is compatible with other sponsor and summit stories; no incompatible rule is present.
Attendee registering for a summit is consistent with registration and seat-count stories; no contradictory constraint found.
Providing directions to summit venue is not in conflict with any other story.
Seeing which summits I'm signed up for to avoid double-booking is compatible with scheduling stories; no incompatible rules exist.
Summit coordinator seeing attendee list for communication aligns with other coordinator/admin access stories; no contradiction.
Listing basic summit info by coordinator is consistent with other summit-detail stories; no conflicting rule.
Listing sponsors for a summit does not impose an incompatible constraint with any sponsor-related story.
Summit coordinator listing an agenda is consistent with other summit and session stories.
Anonymous users seeing number of seats remaining for summit does not conflict with registration or admin seat-management stories.
Showing summit details to anonymous users aligns with other summit information stories and does not contradict them.
Listing all summits for anonymous users is consistent with other summit-list and detail stories.
Learning about sponsorship levels for anonymous users does not conflict with other sponsor/payment stories.
Providing a WYSIWYG editor to authenticated users is not in conflict with other content-editing or viewing stories.
Sponsors linking from job listings to sponsorship profile is consistent with job and sponsor stories; no incompatible rule detected.
Anonymous user learning about posting jobs and contacting sponsorship person does not conflict with any story.
Sponsors posting jobs is compatible with other job board stories and sponsor features.
Authenticated users viewing the job board does not contradict any other story restricting access.
Administrator assigning a room to a timeslot/location to populate schedule aligns with scheduling stories; no incompatible rule present.
Anonymous users seeing the schedule complements room assignment and session acceptance stories without contradiction.
Anonymous users seeing final accepted sessions is compatible with admin acceptance and session listing stories.
Administrator bulk approving sessions is not incompatible with any other story; it complements per-session acceptance stories.
Administrator marking a session as accepted aligns with bulk-approval and notification stories; no conflict detected.
Anonymous users receiving notification when sessions have been evaluated is not contradicted by any story; anonymous submissions and notifications are also requested.
Anonymous users receiving a notification upon submission fits with anonymous submission requests; no conflicting rule says only authenticated receive such notifications.
Authenticated users editing their session does not contradict other stories; anonymous submission and authenticated edit are not presented as mutually exclusive requirements.
Anonymous users registering to speak is consistent with anonymous notification/submission stories; no story forbids anonymous submissions.
Authenticated users submitting sessions is compatible with anonymous submission stories; similarity does not imply conflict.
Sponsor personalizing sponsorship page is consistent with other sponsor/profile stories and does not impose incompatible rules.
Anonymous users seeing summits with timing is consistent with other summit-list/detail items; no conflicting rule present.
Offering sponsorship choices to authenticated users on registration is not contradicted by any story; it aligns with other registration/payment items.
An easily findable registration link for anonymous users does not conflict with other registration or account-creation stories.
Anonymous user registration form request is compatible with other stories; no other story demands registrations be restricted to a different role only.
Finding session information (anonymous) does not conflict with any other story; no incompatible constraint about session visibility exists.
